Documents and embeds, done properly.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Document cards.** Attached documents show as desktop-style cards with a preview.
- **Embed any link.** Paste a link and turn it into a rich embed; media toolbars are always visible when you need them.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.3.10...v0.4.0](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.3.10...v0.4.0)
